title: echinolobium biarticulatum
intro: Echinolobium biarticulatum, commonly known as the Bael fruit tree, is a plant species native to South Asia, known for its medicinal properties. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Echinolobium biarticulatum include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and act as an anti-allergic agent, making it a potential remedy for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
